tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Window and top workspace bar: the deepest layer of the IDE.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Editor and terminal area.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Sidebar, explorer, side panels and the editor tab strip.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: toasts, menus, command palette, active workspace tab.

tokens.name: bg-400
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed item over bg-200/bg-300. Never as a background for ink-faint text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: dividers between panels and between tabs. Carries no meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control border (input, secondary button); ≥3:1 on bg-000 to bg-300.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and code on any bg-*.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, branch name, metadata and icons, on any bg-*.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder, keyboard shortcuts and disabled labels on bg-000 to bg-300 (≥4.5:1). Avoid on bg-400.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Walph neon blue: primary action, active tab, focus, Claude Code "running" status. Base of --grad-brand and --grad-ai. As text, on any bg-* or accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Accent hover and emphasis text on accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind accent text: explorer selection, workspace badge, tab with an unread notification.

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Neon halo (only in shadows and the trace glow): running pulse, active tab, neon cards. Never as a text background.

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Electric indigo: middle/end of the brand and AI gradients, tail of the neon line. Never alone as an action color. on-accent over it: 5.8:1.

tokens.name: accent-3
tokens.usage: Cyan: head of the neon line and start of the AI gradient. Only as light (gradients, trace, AI icons), never as body text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent or on the --grad-brand/--grad-ai gradients (≥5.8:1 at every point).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Claude Code finished (status "done"), tests passed. A teal off the red–green axis; always paired with an icon or a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Claude Code waiting for input or permission (status "attention").

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error, agent failure, destructive action. Coral orange, darker than success and always with an icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind danger text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Alias of accent.

tokens.name: syn-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords: import, export, const, return, async, if. Pastel lilac, away from the UI blue so it does not compete with it. 8:1 on bg-100.

tokens.name: syn-function
tokens.usage: Function and method names, at declaration and call sites.

tokens.name: syn-type
tokens.usage: Types, classes, interfaces and JSX components.

tokens.name: syn-string
tokens.usage: Strings, template literals and import paths.

tokens.name: syn-number
tokens.usage: Numbers, booleans and null/undefined.

tokens.name: syn-constant
tokens.usage: UPPER_CASE constants, enums and regex braces.

tokens.name: syn-property
tokens.usage: Object properties, JSX attributes, JSON keys.

tokens.name: syn-tag
tokens.usage: HTML/JSX tags and CSS selectors.

tokens.name: syn-variable
tokens.usage: Variables and parameters: the default editor text. Alias of ink.

tokens.name: syn-operator
tokens.usage: Operators and punctuation (=, =>, {, ;). Alias of ink-muted.

tokens.name: syn-comment
tokens.usage: Comments, in italics. Alias of ink-faint: 5.4:1 on bg-100, readable without drawing attention.

tokens.name: editor-line-active
tokens.usage: Background of the cursor line in the editor (on bg-100).

tokens.name: editor-selection
tokens.usage: Text selection in the editor and the terminal; the text keeps its syntax color.

tokens.name: editor-match
tokens.usage: Search matches (⌘F) and occurrences of the word under the cursor.

tokens.name: editor-gutter
tokens.usage: Line numbers. Alias of ink-faint.

tokens.name: editor-gutter-active
tokens.usage: Line number of the cursor line.

tokens.name: editor-indent-guide
tokens.usage: Indentation guides, 1px.

tokens.name: ansi-black
tokens.usage: ANSI 0. Used as a background by terminal programs; not a text color on bg-100.

tokens.name: ansi-red
tokens.usage: ANSI 1: errors, FAIL. Same value as danger.

tokens.name: ansi-green
tokens.usage: ANSI 2: PASS, git add. A true green (CLIs expect green), lighter than ansi-red to separate them by luminance.

tokens.name: ansi-yellow
tokens.usage: ANSI 3: warnings. Same value as warning.

tokens.name: ansi-blue
tokens.usage: ANSI 4: directories, links, info.

tokens.name: ansi-magenta
tokens.usage: ANSI 5. A true magenta (CLIs expect magenta); the ❯ prompt uses accent.

tokens.name: ansi-cyan
tokens.usage: ANSI 6.

tokens.name: ansi-white
tokens.usage: ANSI 7.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-black
tokens.usage: ANSI 8: dimmed CLI text (timestamps, dim). 5:1 on bg-100.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-red
tokens.usage: ANSI 9.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-green
tokens.usage: ANSI 10.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-yellow
tokens.usage: ANSI 11.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-blue
tokens.usage: ANSI 12.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-magenta
tokens.usage: ANSI 13.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-cyan
tokens.usage: ANSI 14.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-white
tokens.usage: ANSI 15.

tokens.name: terminal-cursor
tokens.usage: Terminal block cursor, steady (does not blink).

tokens.name: syn-parameter
tokens.usage: Function parameters.

tokens.name: editor-highlight-text
tokens.usage: Other occurrences of the symbol under the cursor (plain text).

tokens.name: editor-highlight-read
tokens.usage: Occurrences where the symbol is read.

tokens.name: editor-highlight-write
tokens.usage: Occurrences where the symbol is written.

tokens.name: editor-inlay-hint
tokens.usage: Inlay hint text (parameter names, inferred types).

tokens.name: editor-inlay-hint-bg
tokens.usage: Inlay hint background.

tokens.name: diagnostic-error
tokens.usage: Error squiggles, gutter marks and Problems icons.

tokens.name: diagnostic-warning
tokens.usage: Warning squiggles, gutter marks and Problems icons.

tokens.name: diagnostic-info
tokens.usage: Information diagnostics.

tokens.name: diagnostic-hint
tokens.usage: Hint diagnostics (dotted, the least visible).

tokens.name: git-modified
tokens.usage: Modified file in the explorer and the Git view (M).

tokens.name: git-added
tokens.usage: Added file (A).

tokens.name: git-untracked
tokens.usage: Untracked file (U).

tokens.name: git-deleted
tokens.usage: Deleted file (D).

tokens.name: git-conflict
tokens.usage: File with merge conflicts (!).

tokens.name: git-renamed
tokens.usage: Renamed file (R).

tokens.name: git-gutter-added
tokens.usage: Editor gutter bar for added lines.

tokens.name: git-gutter-modified
tokens.usage: Editor gutter bar for modified lines.

tokens.name: git-gutter-deleted
tokens.usage: Editor gutter mark for deleted lines.

tokens.name: diff-inserted
tokens.usage: Inserted lines background in the diff view.

tokens.name: diff-deleted
tokens.usage: Deleted lines background in the diff view.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and the command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Shadow of floating surfaces (menus, toasts, palette).

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Accent glow around focused AI surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-neon
tokens.usage: Soft neon shadow under the primary call to action.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty screens and onboarding. Once per screen.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Workspace and editor tabs, buttons, explorer items.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Branch in the workspace tab, shortcuts (⌘1), paths.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon–text gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of tabs and list items; gap between tabs.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button and input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Toast and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Toast margin from the window edge; spacing between groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty screens and onboarding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Explorer items, badges, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, workspace tabs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Toasts, menus, command palette.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Notification counter and status dots.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Toasts, menus and command palette over the editor.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Static neon halo: primary button on hover and elements with a gradient border. At most two per screen.

tokens.name: shadow-neon
tokens.usage: Diffuse glow under cards with a neon border (NeonCard, Claude compose box, AI toast).

duration.note: Subtle motion: transitions up to 320ms. Continuous exceptions are reserved for AI: the status pulse and the neon line (trace). With prefers-reduced-motion, everything becomes 0ms, pulses and trace stop and the border keeps the static gradient.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Hover and press: background color, icon opacity.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Tab switch, active tab indicator, close buttons appearing.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Toast entrance, folder expand/collapse, new tab entering.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Toast exit and workspace bar reordering.

tokens.name: duration-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between blocks in a staggered entrance (welcome screen). At most 6 steps.

tokens.name: duration-pulse
tokens.usage: Cycle of the "running" pulse (the dot breathing). The only continuous motion.

tokens.name: duration-sheen
tokens.usage: Light streak that sweeps across the primary button on hover. One pass, no repeat.

tokens.name: duration-trace
tokens.usage: One full lap of the neon line around a card or tab border while the AI works. Linear, continuous.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances: toast, new tab, menu. Smooth deceleration.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: In-place state changes: active tab, hover, indicator.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits: dismissed toast, closed tab.

tokens.name: ease-breathe
tokens.usage: Status pulse (running), symmetric back and forth.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Only for the neon trace: constant speed around the border.
